extracted.name: My Banana Bread Recipe
extracted.description: Great recipe for My Banana Bread Recipe.
ingredient_lines: 4 sticks unsalted butter at room temperature
instruction_lines: Make sure you have all your ingredients
In a large bowl mix all dry ingredients.
In smaller bowl mash your bananas then add your wet ingredients and mix.
Slowly add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix well.
Pour evenly into 4 bread pans and cook at 350° for an hour and 10 minutes or until toothpick comes out dry and clean.
Let cool. Remove from bread pans and storage bags to keep from going bad. Enjoy your bread.
